title: Missile strike on Ukraine's Kharkiv region kills five, destroys infrastructure
summary: A Russian missile strike on the town of Merefa in Ukraine’s Kharkiv region has killed five people and wounded at least 18, damaging homes, businesses and public buildings in an area far from the front lines, officials said Monday.
